synthetic_prerequisite.evidence: All four fixed-support corrected synthetic equations pass the original trajectory, function, kernel, support/amplitude and valid-fit gates. Known-parameter and physical controls pass; saved-evidence review independently verified all recorded outcomes and budgets.
synthetic_prerequisite.transfer_boundary: The real experiment applies the validated coefficient identification mechanism to the frozen TASK3 comparison. It does not assume that a real function family or true real-system coefficients were identified by synthetic truth.

scope.common_start: A06 mass, edge stiffness and original damping-basis coefficients; all local g start at norm(C_A06)/norm(P), all tau at geomspace(0.06,1.6,10), and added amplitudes at zero.
scope.shared_fit: A and B/neither have the same deterministic no-added-term problem and common start, so one fit serves both identities. The other three supports each start from the same anchor; they are not warm-started from a dense-B fit.
scope.support_choice: Use complete-val checkpoint scores and the existing choose_support allowance max(1e-8,0.01*best), then fewest nonzero optional amplitudes, lower score and fixed support order.
scope.alias_reporting: If B selects neither, A and B are the same equation and coefficient set. Their two reports are not independent evidence.

causal_and_numerical_review.training_window: Start momentum integration from x[10], the 100 ms forecast origin. Use every subsequent available 10 ms observation up to the frozen record limit, the supplied origin power held forward, and the corresponding unknown origin memory moment.
causal_and_numerical_review.historical_input: Using origin power to reconstruct the observed history is the inherited causal model approximation. The new momentum fit does not assert that this power was measured throughout the preceding history.
causal_and_numerical_review.train_only: No hidden-state truth, labels, event metadata, future power, test trajectory or source-specific routing enters the fitted equation. Train scales use complete train and actual available lengths.
causal_and_numerical_review.nuisance: Eliminate event-specific initial memory moments from the train equations. They are not exported; all formal predictions use the same three-GN initializer from eleven measured q/v frames.
causal_and_numerical_review.single_row: An event with one retained nonzero integral time has a rank-nine nuisance span covering its balanced force equation. Omitting its identically zero projected contribution is algebraically exact under the registered row grid. Record its ID and retain it in train normalization, scales and all formal scoring.
causal_and_numerical_review.retained_rows: Use each 50 ms point plus the final available frame. With at least two retained times, enforce the original full nuisance rank/conditioning check. No padded observations or added weak-direction truncation.
causal_and_numerical_review.inherited_solver: Retain positive physical coefficients, bounded optional coordinates/time constants, column scaling, conditioning gates, bounded-solve stationarity check and analytic envelope gradient from the reviewed synthetic correction.
causal_and_numerical_review.serialization: Freeze the complete JointMachineLocalModel state and declared support. The dedicated strict loader validates field names, shapes, finite float64 values and reconstructed buffers, preserving learned edge/damping/dictionary coefficients.

iteration_and_failure_contract.complete_val_cadence: Initial-tau linear optimum, every ten accepted iterations and final accepted point without duplicate evaluation.
iteration_and_failure_contract.checkpoint_selection: Earliest minimum complete finite val 1-second/3-second event-equal normalized MSE; actual available target lengths are used.
iteration_and_failure_contract.accepted_vs_trial: The cached last evaluated line-search trial does not replace the accepted state. A valid selected full-val checkpoint wins; otherwise retain the last accepted finite state or original anchor for disclosed failure scoring.
iteration_and_failure_contract.fit_failure: Record the failed support fit and continue the remaining registered supports. Complete formal A/B train and val scoring even when fits or trajectory goals fail.
iteration_and_failure_contract.no_valid_val: If no candidate has a valid complete-val score, record that B selection failed and use the A equation as the disclosed fallback. This is not successful evidence for selecting the no-added-term structure.
iteration_and_failure_contract.formal_failure: At each integration step, one failed batch may be isolated once per event. Retain nonfinite, uncovered and unresolved cases, null invalid/full-cohort metrics, and their coverage counts.

evaluation.scoring: Hash-bound TASK3 scoring and fixed official truth labels; instability positive, complete confusion counts, recall/miss/false-alarm rates and explicit classifiable coverage. Common-frequency output retains the declared zero-deviation convention.
evaluation.freeze: Initial candidate/preprocessing freeze precedes val reading. Final A/B support, coefficients and scales are selection-closed before formal evaluation.
evaluation.test_follow_through: After this stage, bind the same final freeze in a separately registered one-use test stage for all 76 events; fitting failure or RMSE does not waive that full evaluation requirement.

budget_reconciliation.nuisance_qr_svd_solves_each: 600 * 346 = 207600 maximum, less when a record contributes exactly zero projected information.
budget_reconciliation.accounting: Formal bounds include ordinary batches and one isolated attempt per event for both steps; full-val monitor has one batch attempt. Internal BVLS iterations remain bounded by the reviewed solver.

limitations: This is a comparison on the previously exposed fixed TASK3 benchmark, not an independent confirmation population.

Fixed-support synthetic recovery verifies the coefficient solver; real optional-family selection is established by the preregistered complete-val comparison, not by mapping synthetic family identities onto real data.
Zero projected information is a property of the retained one-time equation design, not a general claim that all observations in that event contain no information.
Passing synthetic gates does not guarantee real trajectory accuracy or true real-system coefficient identification. Real metrics and coverage remain the evidence.
This review approves the fit stage. Test uses the same frozen model under its own exact manifest/budget registration; model promotion and deployment changes remain outside this scope.

independent_review.reviewed: Exact normalized proposal/protocol, changed post-origin momentum implementation, joint fit/test evaluator and strict serialization, stage authorization/one-use runner, frozen metadata, existing full-roster reader and scoring/selection helpers.
